questions.question: Which metric measures the proportion of all predictions that were correct?
A medical test identifies 90 sick patients correctly but also marks 30 healthy people as sick. Which metric is directly affected by these false positives?
Recall answers the question:
options: Of all predicted positives, how many were correct?
How many total predictions were correct?
Of all actual positives, how many did the model find?
How close are predicted values to actual values?

questions.question: Which metric provides a balance between precision and recall?
A spam detector catches every spam email but also marks many genuine emails as spam. The model most likely has:
In a highly imbalanced dataset, accuracy can be misleading because:
options: A model can achieve high accuracy by predicting only the majority class

questions.question: Which metric is commonly used for regression problems?
What does Mean Absolute Error (MAE) measure?
options: The average absolute difference between predictions and actual values

questions.question: Compared to MAE, Mean Squared Error (MSE) penalizes:
A model predicts house prices. One prediction is off by ₹50,000 while another is off by ₹5,000. Which metric will punish the ₹50,000 error disproportionately more?
The R² (coefficient of determination) score measures:
options: The proportion of variance explained by the model

questions.question: An R² score of 1 indicates:
options: The model performs worse than random guessing
The model explains none of the variance
A perfect fit to the data

questions.question: Error analysis is primarily performed to:
options: Understand why the model makes mistakes
Reduce the number of features automatically

questions.question: A classifier consistently mistakes cats for dogs but rarely confuses dogs for birds. This observation is an example of:
Which tool is especially useful for analyzing classification errors across classes?
A model predicts every patient as healthy in a disease dataset where only 2% are sick. The model achieves 98% accuracy. What is the biggest issue?
options: Accuracy is misleading because recall for sick patients is very poor.
The model has perfect F1 score.

questions.question: Which metric would be most important for a cancer detection system where missing a positive case is extremely dangerous?
Which metric would be most important for an email spam filter where incorrectly marking genuine emails as spam should be minimized?
After performing error analysis, a data scientist discovers that most mistakes occur in low-light images. What is the MOST reasonable next step?
options: Collect more low-light training data or improve preprocessing

questions.question: Which sequence best represents a mature machine learning evaluation workflow?
options: Train → Compute metrics → Analyze errors → Improve the model
